notes.title: Update 1.5.31. Future plans, free DLC.
notes.notes: [p]We are pleased to announce the release of a major update, 1.5.31. A lot of work has been done.[/p][p]The patch took a very long time to prepare, and we would like to apologize once again. The long development time was due to the fact that we completely rewrote the project structure in order to make future patches faster and easier to work with. In addition, we had broken saves, achievements, and many critical issues that we have been fixing all this time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/332a4da7d2cb3d39860cd039afef816bbe5a4c11.png"][/img][/p][p]Some important features have also been added, and a free add-on that allows you to open a hotel next to a cafe is half finished. We are currently working on the add-on, and soon everyone will be able to get it for free and expand their business.[/p][p][/p][p]Next on the agenda is to review the game mechanics, animations, interface, and much more, which we are already working on![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/17d81f0f53327e074dfcb9c21ea3ee1eaaefb74b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Major changes:[/h3][p][/p][p]• Added a seaside level, now you can open a cafe on the beach overlooking the ocean;[/p][p]• Fixed saves;[/p][p]• Work is underway on the Cafe Owner Simulator Hotel DLC;[/p][p]• Fishing and catching fish mechanics;[/p][p]• Crab catching;[/p][p]• Added 5 new seafood dishes;[/p][p]• Game saves are now available in multiple slots.[/p][p]• Cloud saves in Steam Cloud.[/p][p]• Improved balance of visitor reviews.[/p][p]• Added more variety to review texts.[/p][p]• Game balance changes (changed prices in the store and some rewards).[/p][p]• More tasks are now available to complete;[/p][p]• Fixed some critical issues with tornadoes;[/p][p]• Added a club at sea level, now in the evenings your visitors can have a good time listening to loud music in the club on the -1 floor of your establishment;[/p][p]• Items could sometimes get stuck in the air, such as vases with flowers — fixed;[/p][p]• Added emotion panels for visitors.[/p][p]• Changed employee avatars.[/p][p]• Added sounds of footsteps on different surfaces.[/p][p]• Reduced and balanced the brightness of materials.[/p][p]• Added textures for colorful materials, now the painted wall surface is not as smooth and looks more realistic;[/p][p]• Added the sale of pies in the cafe (cafe-bar) instead of removing them;[/p][p]• Changed the weather system, lighting has become more realistic, weather and effects;[/p][p]• Added an “overflow” shader in the pop-up window when buying or selling;[/p][p]• New, more realistic water;[/p][p]• Added hotkeys for actions in the bottom panel, where you can move objects, hire an employee, sell installed equipment, etc;[/p][p]• Added the ability to change the lighting level in lamps.[/p][p]• The cleaner could approach trash that had been cleaned up by the player — fixed.[/p][p]• Limited the height of urinal installation.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug with the waiter, now he only serves food if the customer is seated at the table.[/p][p][/p][p][img notes.title: Major patch 1.4.105 + Farm DLC!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear cafe owners,[/b]

We are pleased to announce the release of a major patch for Cafe Owner Simulator, containing many improvements and exciting new features that will enhance your gameplay. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742990/Cafe_Owner_Simulator__Farm_DLC/

This update brings significant improvements including a new user interface, a wide selection of new furniture and improved animations for both customers and employees. In addition, we have addressed several critical issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable game play. Below is a detailed list of additions and fixes included in this update:

[h2]Added:[/h2]

- New user interface
- Lots of new furniture
- New animations for customers and workers
- Customers can now sit at tables together instead of one per table
- Improved paint system

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]

- Textures have been optimized, and RAM and VRAM usage has also been optimized
- The game would sometimes crash when trying to remove debris or leaves
- Game crashed due to tornado issues
- Sometimes, after taking a customer's order, the customer would get stuck and the game would crash
- Player could not move green dishes to the menu if there were no green ingredients for them
- Various notification issues
- Some UI elements overlap with others
- Font size issues on different resolutions
- An issue that caused Avazon to sometimes not work in mail missions
- Critical popcorn issue where ordering popcorn blocked the cooking process
- Problems with hamburgers and doner related products and green highlighting on the menu screen
- Problems with some dishes and their ingredients
- Unable to paint some parts of the ceiling in post jobs
- Fixed some translations
- Problems with using tools, in particular pressing F, G and RMB
- Problems with repairing windows in post jobs 4 and 5
- Clients would sometimes appear in the wrong place
- Players had free space in the fridge but could not buy ingredients
- Trash on tables was not accounted for in the trash user interface
- Post missions 5 and 6 incorrectly displayed new logos after completion
- In post mission 7, the player could pick up trash in the cafe next to the door
- UI issue with achievement screen on ultra-wide screens
- When starting the game from the beginning without saves, the game asked to delete old saves
- Critical issue where furniture would disappear when loading the game
- Problem with current weather indicator texts
- Tiles are often not highlighted when placing floors
- Debris on new tables levitates in the air
- After a tornado, some players could not find trash
- If all kitchen furniture and tables were placed before a task with smoke detectors, the task with food boxes did not progress.

We are also happy to announce that our team is hard at work on the next patch, which will feature new levels and new post missions. These additions are designed to bring new challenges and exciting content to make your experience in Cafe Owner Simulator dynamic and enjoyable.

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. Stay tuned for updates and happy running!

[i][b]Best wishes,  
Second Reality team.
[/b][/i]

Devlog # 2 - "Critical changes and voice control".
Devlog #1 - "Demo version".
Changes in the concept of the Cafe Owner Simulator.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/07f215a9d6c231cde562587983b964b518d3e9e1.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We are working on a new concept, before that there was one large building of the establishment in the game, with the possibility of expansion, but we thought that this approach would be boring, and the gameplay would be short. Now we are working on the following idea: the main goal of the game is to open your own restaurant business and lead it to success, but without money and experience, this is impossible, so you need to take orders in different parts of the country, where you will need to clean, restore and equip a cafe, restaurants or bars - to your taste, but in order to fulfill the order as indicated in the assignment, it can be a Chinese restaurant, a cafe on the side of the road, an Irish pub in the center of a metropolis or fast food, and of course - Cafe Owner Simulator is not just renovation and decor, and also a business simulator, so you will need to think over a strategy for each specific business for customers and, as a result, successfully open your own.
We plan to introduce from 6 to 10 different locations, with different seasons, landscapes, their own standard of living and the preferences of local residents, you will need to study this data and based on them - plan a business.
For each order - you will receive a monetary reward, reputation and evaluation, and after completing all orders - you will have the opportunity to open your own business.

We'd love to hear your feedback on the game and the new concept here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1498140/discussions/0/3175575850969120548/
